hypotheses.persona: Elderly resident with mobility and sensory impairments living independently
hypotheses.rationale: Consistent morning health routines (meds, hearing aids, BP cuff) and mobility aids persist. Day 8 adds coffee (standard morning ritual) and TV (leisure), reinforcing independent living. No evidence of a second person.

hypotheses.persona: Caregiver living with an elderly person
hypotheses.rationale: Remains theoretically possible if the caregiver is absent during observation windows, but lack of distinct caregiver artifacts (e.g., second set of keys, different meal prep items) keeps probability low.

hypotheses.persona: Standard working adult with temporary medical needs
hypotheses.rationale: Discarded. Permanent assistive devices and chronic management tools are inconsistent with temporary injuries.
